description: T23 TiDB 8.5 physical layout / ID / cache table operations. Product semantics frozen at R9 (f4fe758d): AUTO_RANDOM create/alter adjudication, table options (AUTO_RANDOM_BASE/AUTO_ID_CACHE/SHARD_ROW_ID_BITS/PRE_SPLIT_REGIONS), CACHE/NOCACHE + ATTRIBUTES, SET TIFLASH REPLICA, standalone SPLIT + COMPACT with integer-handle BETWEEN bound/min-step adjudication; common-handle/index BETWEEN and BY forms stay bounded-unproven. NATIVE EXECUTION INPUTS FROZEN — no native case has run. metadata_cases are fixture experiments grouped by the authorization card: A = AUTO_RANDOM/ID/clustered-mode/MySQL-vendor/base-controls + alter matrix; B = CACHE/ATTRIBUTES/SPLIT on the unistore anchor; C = TiFlash declaration + COMPACT — TiFlash-positive arms require a real TiFlash store and stay open.

metadata_cases.note: Mode flip arm: audit runs under SET GLOBAL tidb_enable_clustered_index='off' and must reject, complementing A-auto-random-first-path pass under int_only. Scope/session mechanics: the variable is global+session scoped; SET GLOBAL applies to new connections only, and both the runner client and the product provider open fresh connections, so the flip is observed through session SHOW VARIABLES exactly as the product reads it. Setup records and asserts the baseline (int_only on this stack) before mutation; teardown restores that recorded baseline and verifies it — the restore target is the verified pre-mutation value, not an assumed constant. alter-primary-key is a SHOW CONFIG startup knob — the apk=true axis is a config-mount authorization item, not runtime SQL.
